title: German group reproducing the effect

tellings.quote:
>> There's another group I'm working with
in Germany who's reproducing this. So,

plain: A group in Germany is reproducing the propulsion effect that Charles Buhler, a NASA scientist who says his team has built antigravity-style propulsion, describes. Buhler tells Michels he is working with them himself: "There's another group I'm working with in Germany who's reproducing this." If it holds, the effect would not depend on one lab alone.
